content.text:
Done — the flight ran Feb 10–14, 2027 (Auckland time) and everything is now paused. Recap:

**Spend / delivery (X-reported, not installs):**
- Spend: **$344.98** of the $350 budget
- Impressions: **850,143**
- Link clicks: **701** (~$0.49 per click)

**Installs:** X cannot see installs — the site has no X pixel and there's no app-install campaign — so I can't report an install count from this account. Link clicks to orbiloom.app/love (701) are the closest proxy I have; the landing page does the install conversion. Any install figure you see elsewhere (App Store Connect, etc.) comes from your own analytics, not from this campaign.

**What I ran:**
- One campaign "Orbiloom Valentine's Installs 2027", three line items promoting three of your four approved posts (all iOS-only platform targeting, ALL_ON_TWITTER, LINK_CLICKS goal; sanctioned countries — Iran, North Korea, Cuba, Syria — aren't targetable in the location catalog, so no delivery there):
  - Post 2151999341984599416 ("Small things deserve a page") — 315 clicks, 358,173 impressions, $152.46
  - Post 2152180535917362170 ("Give someone a reason") — 322 clicks, 365,125 impressions, $152.86
  - Post 2152542923785236383 (iOS/worldwide/sanctioned copy) — 64 clicks, 126,845 impressions, $39.66
- Post 2152361729849701644 ("Please take a look…") was never promoted — it's a weak ask with no offer and no deadline.
- Management: after day 1, post 4's CTR/CPC lagged, so I trimmed it from $20 to $10/day (Feb 11), then paused it entirely on Feb 12 and shifted its budget evenly to posts 1 and 2 ($35/day each). Both outperformed for the rest of the flight.
- All copy says "Install by February 14, 2027", which stayed accurate through the whole run including Valentine's Day itself, so no creative edits were needed.
- Campaign and line items are paused/ended; nothing is left spending.

**Notes/caveats:** Budget was nearly fully used ($5 headroom). If you want to keep momentum after Feb 14, the 14-day collection framing is now expired and the copy would need updating — I didn't touch it since you approved only those four posts.
